title: Legal motion and removal petition concerning the January 27 Ministry of Culture gathering
reason: A legal motion, online petition, and reporting about the January 27 gathering do not establish a new physical assembly in February.
notes: The Art Newspaper search result describes signatories seeking the culture minister’s removal after a January protest. The Miami Herald search result concerns the January 27 gathering itself. Signatures, the legal filing, and January attendance are not February demonstrators.
